text: dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact（DSH Web 插件）：在侧栏底部查看 OpenCode GO 套餐用量。它通过同源路由获取用量，并以可收拢组件展示滚动 5 小时、每周和每月额度；展开时还显示用量进度、时间进度与重置时间。你也可以在聊天中运行 /opencode-go 查看文字摘要，或刷新组件数据。适合需要随时了解 OpenCode GO 额度的 DSH 用户。使用前需配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，插件会向 opencode.ai 查询用量。

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact (DSH Web plugin): check OpenCode GO usage in a collapsible sidebar widget. It shows rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly quotas, progress and reset times. Run /opencode-go in chat for a text summary. Configure OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY; usage is fetched from opencode.ai.
想在 DSH 侧栏随时看 OpenCode GO 还剩多少额度
有没有办法同时查看 OpenCode GO 的五小时、周和月用量？
我想把模型套餐用量面板收起来，省出侧栏空间
dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact 的功能「可收拢的额度面板」：侧栏底部显示 OpenCode GO 的滚动 5 小时、周和月额度；点击标题或箭头可收起或展开，并显示进度和重置时间。
dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact 的功能「聊天用量查询」：在 DSH 聊天中运行 /opencode-go，返回滚动 5 小时、周和月额度的文字摘要及状态。
dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact 使用前须知：需配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，插件通过 opencode.ai 查询套餐用量。见 lib/index.js:54-56、149-159

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact：可收拢的 **OpenCode GO** 用量小组件，用于 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。

这是 [`@astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage`](https://github.com/Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage) `1.5.0` 的修改版（它的上游是 [`yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage`](https://github.com/yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage)）。保留原来的数据源、同源代理、`/opencode-go` 命令和 `x-opencode-session` 修复，把侧边栏底部的用量面板改成可收拢的一行，并修了一些问题。

[English](README.en.md)

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 界面：| 收拢（默认） | 展开 |
|---|---|
|  |  |

- **收拢**：一行显示三个窗口的百分比，箭头位于分割线中间，没有外框。
- **展开**：5 小时 / 周 / 月三条用量条，下面各有一条时间进度条，右侧是重置倒计时。
- 箭头方向跟随状态：展开向下，收拢向上；点击箭头或标题行都可以切换。
- 状态保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，刷新或重启后保持上次选择。

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 功能：- 侧边栏底部常驻，默认收拢，不占工作区高度
- 5h / 周 / 月额度百分比、时间进度、重置倒计时
- **同源代理**：host 端请求 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`，浏览器只访问 `/opencode-go/usage`，API key 不进入前端
- `/opencode-go` 聊天命令，输出同样三个窗口的文本
- 运行时注入 `x-opencode-session`，修复 OpenCode GO 网关的 `400 MissingSessionID`
- 中文 / English 跟随 DSH 的界面语言，实时切换
- 没有 npm 自动更新检查；更新通过 GitHub

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 安装：适用 DSH `0.1.7` 及以上（含 `0.2.x`），已在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证。

先移除原插件（如果装过），避免两个插件争用同一个用量路由和 `/opencode-go` 命令，并在侧边栏出现两个小组件：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage
```

然后从 GitHub 安装本仓库：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhufei1000/dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact
```

安装后完全退出并重新打开 DSH；Web 用户重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。

如果你用的是 **web profile**，把 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 安装：API key 仍然使用 DSH 的 credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，不需要重新填写。没有配置过的话，在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里加：

```yaml
OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY: sk-...
```

或者直接使用环境变量 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`。

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 配置：在 **设置 → 插件 → 插件配置** 中修改，字段都是 volatile，改完即时生效：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | API key 的 credential 引用 |
| `baseUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/go` | OpenCode GO 网关地址 |
| `cacheMs` | `30000` | host 端用量缓存 TTL |
| `injectSessionHeader` | `true` | 为 OpenCode GO 请求注入 `x-opencode-session` |

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 与上游 1.5.0 的差异：- 侧边栏底部面板可手动收拢 / 展开，收拢后只占一行
- 收拢拉手改成分割线中间的**纯箭头**，没有胶囊边框或底色
- 中文紧凑标签用「五小时 / 周 / 月」，避免阿拉伯数字 `5` 与汉字视觉高度不一致
- host 端修复 `Request` 对象被 `String()` 成 `[object Request]`、导致 session header 不注入的问题
- 注入 header 时保留 `Request` 自带的 headers
- 标题行不再重复声明 `role="button"`，只保留箭头按钮这一个语义控件
- 30 秒时间条 tick 只在展开时运行
- 移除 `setOpen` updater 里的 localStorage 副作用
- 修复紧凑模式在“已加载但无窗口数据”时仍显示“加载中…”
- 移除 npm 自动更新检查（本仓库通过 GitHub 分发）

完整变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 兼容性：- DSH：`>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0`（peerDependencies）
- Node.js：`>=18`

```bash

```

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · 开发：`lib/client.js` 是手写的 DSH client bundle（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），`lib/index.js` 是 host 端，`lib/opencode-session.js` 负责 session header 注入。没有构建步骤，改完直接重载 DSH 即可。

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact：A collapsible **OpenCode GO** usage widget for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact：This is a modified fork of [`@astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage`](https://github.com/Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage) `1.5.0` (itself a fork of [`yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage`](https://github.com/yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage)). It keeps the same usage source, same-origin proxy, `/opencode-go` command and `x-opencode-session` fix, and turns the sidebar footer into a collapsible one-line widget.

[中文](README.md)

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · Screenshots：| Collapsed (default) | Expanded |
|---|---|
|  |  |

- **Collapsed**: one line with all three percentages; the arrow sits in the middle of the divider and has no box.
- **Expanded**: 5-hour / weekly / monthly quota bars, time-progress bars and reset countdowns.
- The arrow points down when expanded and up when collapsed; clicking the arrow or the title row toggles it.
- The state is persisted in `localStorage` and survives reloads.

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · Features：- Persistent sidebar-footer widget, collapsed by default; no workspace height cost
- 5h / weekly / monthly quota percentages, time progress and reset time
- **Same-origin proxy**: the host calls `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`; the browser only sees `/opencode-go/usage`, and the API key never enters the frontend
- `/opencode-go` chat command with the same numbers as text
- Runtime `x-opencode-session` injection, fixing OpenCode GO's `400 MissingSessionID`
- Chinese / English follows the DSH UI language and switches live
- No npm update check; updates come from GitHub

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · Install：Requires DSH `0.1.7` or newer (including `0.2.x`); verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`.

Remove the original plugin first if it is installed, so both do not fight over the same usage route and `/opencode-go` command and show two widgets:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage
```

Then install this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhufei1000/dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact
```

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · Install：Fully quit and reopen DSH. Web users should restart `dsh web` and refresh the page. For the **web profile**, replace `desktop` with `web`.

The API key still comes from the DSH credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`; no extra configuration is needed. To set it:

```yaml
OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY: sk-...
```

in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, or export `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`.

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · Configuration：Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration. All fields are volatile and hot-apply:

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | credential reference for the API key |
| `baseUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/go` | OpenCode GO gateway base |
| `cacheMs` | `30000` | host-side usage cache TTL |
| `injectSessionHeader` | `true` | inject `x-opencode-session` into OpenCode GO requests |

dsh-opencode-go-usage-compact README · Differences from upstream 1.5.0：- Collapsible sidebar-footer widget; collapsed mode is one line
- The handle is a bare arrow in a gap in the divider — no pill, border or background
- Chinese compact labels use 「五小时 / 周 / 月」 so the Arabic `5` does not look smaller than the CJK labels
- Host fix: `Request` inputs were stringified as `[object Request]`, so the session header was skipped
- Preserve existing `Request` headers when injecting the session header
- The title row no longer duplicates `role="button"`; the arrow is the single semantic control
- The 30-second time-bar tick only runs while expanded
- localStorage write moved out of the `setOpen` updater
- Compact mode shows `—` instead of the loading text when data loaded but no windows are present
- npm update check removed (distribution is via GitHub)
